intro: Section 23.4 covers family therapy and couples therapy: indications, the initial consultation, interviewing families, frequency and length of treatment, the major schools from Bowen and structural to strategic, narrative and psychoeducational models, modified formats such as family group and social network therapy, paradox and reframing, and the types, indications, contraindications and goals of couples therapy. A dashed box adds the current APA guideline on family interventions in schizophrenia.
objectives: State the indications for family therapy and how a first family consultation and interview are run.
Compare the schools of family and couple therapy by founders, core concepts, goals and techniques (Table 23-6).
Recognize modified techniques: family group therapy, social network therapy, paradoxical therapy and reframing.
Describe the types of couples therapy (individual, individual couples, conjoint, four-way, group and combined).
Apply the indications, contraindications and goals of couples therapy to a case.
